text:
nora: Quick QA from the beta session 90% of users run console in dark mode. Two things stood out: the heatmap legend is confusing (low/mid/high mapping) and keyboard focus rings disappear on our chart controls when using high-contrast mode. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ux/starlight-heatmap.png eli: Good catch. For the heatmap legend I think explicit numeric bins + gentle separators will help. Right now it's just a gradient from navy -> orange and people don't know thresholds. Maybe show ticks: 0, 10k, 100k, 1M. Also consider labeling "Requests" vs "Tokens" depending on the metric. samir: On the focus ring, I can repro in Windows high-contrast: the default focus outline is suppressed by our chart wrapper's outline: none. We should avoid removing native outlines, or provide a custom 3px high-contrast ring using box-shadow. Also ensure focusable SVG elements get a visible stroke. claire: UX suggestion: heatmap color scale is fine but we should add an inverted option for people who prefer cooler->hotter mapping (some users expect cold = blue, hot = red). Provide a toggle and remember preference in localStorage. nora: Accessibility note: we need aria-describedby on the legend so screen readers announce the current bin ranges and unit. Also for small cells, add title tooltips with exact value. samir: Proposed CSS for focus ring (rough): ```css .chart-control:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.08), 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) inset; border-radius: 6px; } svg [tabindex] { stroke-width: 2px; /* makes focus visible */ } ``` Works in my local high-contrast test. design-bot: Accessibility checklist update: added "legend aria-describedby" and "focus ring on chart controls" to agenda. Also ran contrast simulation: heatmap mid-tone (rrggbb #6f7fb2) vs bg (#0a0f14) => 4.2:1 (needs 4.5:1 for body-size text). Recommendation: slightly boost mid-tone brightness or add a strong contrast outline for hovered/focused cells. eli: For legend IA, sample markup idea: ```html
00 - 10,000
...
``` This should read cleanly to screen readers. claire: tiny copy nit: the legend uses "High"/"Low" 9I prefer "High activity" / "Low activity" to be explicit. Minor but helps folks glancing quickly. nora: Action items: samir will land focus-ring patch + test in high-contrast modes, eli will prototype legend markup with numeric ticks and aria, claire will add copy tweak and preference toggle, nora will run a quick user test on Friday with 5 folks using dark mode. We'll aim to ship in next beta. Thanks! :rocket:
